Name: (CP) Dacar Rasmodia Seasonal anime style portraits
Author: DacarTheGorilla
Description:
I really wanted to do this so here it is!

[color=#ff0000][size=4][b]This isn't the original mod! This is only has the HD Portraits, no sprites included! For the original mod you can go to requirements!
[/b][/size][/color][b]
[color=#ff0000][size=4]If you were previously using the original Dacar's Rasmodia Portraits make sure to remove it! Having both at the same time will create conflicts and neither will load![/size][/color][/b]

This mod includes every option the original one has! Such as:
[list]
[*]Seasonal outfits for Rasmodia, with hatless versions included[/*]
[*]Festival outfits, one for every festival SCA has[/*]
[*]12 types of hairstyles for Rasmodia, with multiple configurations[/*]
[*]New earrings for RRRR that can be used even without having RRRR installed[/*]
[/list]
This mod has Wedding Reception protraits [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31890]here[/url]﻿! 

[size=4][b]All options need to be configurated in the original mod![/b][/size]

[b][color=#00ff00]-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/color]
[color=#00ff00]**--Instructions for 1.6 CP for Portaiture--*
Just download the mod and put it in the mods folder.
In order to see the portraits you'll need Portraiture and do one of this two things:

-Once inside the game press "P" (by default it may be different depending on your settings) until you see HDP

-In Portraiture config setting  change this to not have to cycle through your portraits:
"active": "HDP" 
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/color][/b]
